findings.summary: tick.md guards trigger-body parsing behind `[ -n "$trigger_body" ]`, so an empty rendered body bypasses the authoritative parseTerminationFromBody (which would throw on the empty string) and lets tick-entry --run default to 0/0 — structurally the silent-fallback shape R5 forbids. Not a blocker: the closed production loop never produces an empty body (bin/deep-research-loop.sh:187 seeds {"seed":true} and the continuation put at tick.md:117 always writes both counters, hard-failing first if termination is absent from run_output), so reaching it requires an out-of-band trigger record. Routing the empty case into the parser instead of skipping it would close the last silent-reset path.
